title: Open Harness Protocol - Portable Action Policy Schema
description: Schema for a deterministic, last-match-wins action policy (RFC-0015). Evaluation is local and synchronous, so every adapter can enforce the same rules.

default.description: Verdict when no rule matches. Defaults to ask: an unclassified action is not pre-approved.

rules.description: Ordered rules. Later matches override earlier ones.

id.description: Unique identifier, reported with the verdict.

match.description: All declared conditions must hold. A condition whose input is absent makes the rule not match.

path_glob.description: Shell-style glob against the forward-slash normalized target path.

command_regex.description: Python regular expression searched against the command text.

reason.description: Why this verdict exists; surfaced to the caller on denial.
